## Where the school money went

The district spent 4.2 million euros on schools last year. Maintenance took the largest share at 1.8 million euros, ahead of salaries at 1.3 million, supplies at 0.6 million and transport at 0.5 million.

The budget was approved unanimously, the chair noted, calling it 'a responsible plan for our children'.

One parent group has asked for the next meeting to be held in the evening.
